thread_messages.text: Looking for a Solidity dev to build our FairWork escrow contracts with Hardhat tests and oracle integration. Total budget is 3.0 MATIC.

I can do this in 3 milestones. M1: FairWork.sol core escrow for 1.0 MATIC by Nov 5. M2: Oracle progress recording and arbitrator voting for 1.0 MATIC by Nov 18. M3: Deployment scripts and testnet verification for 1.0 MATIC by Nov 30.
Sounds fair. We need 90% test coverage on M1 and M2. GitHub is https://github.com/fairwork-team/contracts on main.
